messages:
Ivy Nakamura: Quick one from usability testing: users expect the exported filename to reflect filters and sort. Right now we always produce export.csv which is ambiguous.
Paul Gomez: Good call. Suggest filename pattern: <dataset>-preview-<filtersHash>-<sortKey>-<timestamp>.zip for ZIP exports, and .csv for simple exports. Keep it short though.
Nadia Fisher: UX note: include a small copy line in modal: "File will be named: support-data-preview-abc123-sim-desc-20260305.zip" so users know what to expect.
Omar El-Sayed: Accessibility nit: screen readers need to announce when export is ready and the filename. Use aria-live to say: "Export ready: support-data-preview-abc123.zip. Download started."
Ivy Nakamura: Also decision: should exports include current column order? I think yes, preserve order + visible columns only by default. Add a toggle: "Use table column order".
Paul Gomez: Implementation detail: when toggled, client sends visible_columns[]=preview_text,rerank_score,owner. Server should honor order param.
Nadia Fisher: Copy tweak: modal subtitle change from "Choose format" -> "Choose file type & columns". Primary CTA: "Start export". Secondary: "Save mapping".
Omar El-Sayed: Performance constraint: if exporting embeddings and total size > 100MB warn: "Large download — recommended to use queued job." Provide estimated size and an opt-in checkbox.
export-helper-bot: Note: export job created (id: 6f1e2c). Poll /exports/6f1e2c/status for progress. ETA ~ 3 min. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ivy Nakamura: Small front-end a11y: when modal opens, focus should land on format radio group. Also add keyboard shortcut hint: "Press Enter to start export".
Paul Gomez: CSV header suggestion: filename header row = `id,preview_text,rerank_score,owner,metadata`. For ZIP include vectors.npy + manifest.json describing filter_hash and column_order.
Nadia Fisher: Manifest example text in helper: `{"dataset":"support-data","filters":"abc123","columns":["preview_text","rerank_score"]}` but ensure we escape it visually and explain it's metadata for re-import.
Omar El-Sayed: Backend: job should store export parameters for audit and reproduceability. Also support cancel via DELETE /exports/:id. Frontend should surface cancel button in notifications.
Ivy Nakamura: Tiny UI idea: after export completes show a toast with two buttons: "Download" and "Open in Console" which opens the exports list. Helps enterprise workflows.
Paul Gomez: For small exports (<2k rows) do client stream and set Content-Disposition with the friendly filename. For larger jobs return pre-signed URL when ready.
Nadia Fisher: Accessibility final: when users have a saved mapping selected, announce it in the modal like "Using mapping: support-summary. Press M to change mapping." and ensure that mapping dropdown is reachable by keyboard.
export-helper-bot: Action created: DX-4402 "Export filenames, manifest, and a11y announcements" assigned to Ivy. :white_check_mark:
Ivy Nakamura: I'll update the Figma and the copy doc; will include manifest schema and filename examples. Thanks team!
